crossRefs.note: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
“Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which…
He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes…
He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
Those along the road are those who hear, then the devil comes, and takes away the word from their heart, that they may…
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
“You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for…
The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

parallels.note: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
“Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,
and as he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

translations.web: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
translations.bsb: “A farmer went out to sow his seed. And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, where it was trampled, and the birds of the air devoured it.
translations.kjv: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
translations.asv: The sower went forth to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden under foot, and the birds of the heaven devoured it.
